## [PERF] Derived performance estimates

| Metric | Derivation | Estimated value | Needs field validation |
|--------|-----------|-----------------|----------------------|
| Conditional theoretical max speed | 159 RPM x pi x 5.8 cm / 60 | 48.3 cm/s if a 159 RPM motor directly drives a 58 mm wheel at no load | YES - verify wheel coupling, wheel type, load, battery sag |
| Turn accuracy | `runAngle` stops when `abs(error) <= 1.0` | code target +/-1.0 degree, real accuracy unknown | YES - run 10 turns |
| Encoder command resolution | `1 cm / 25 counts` | 0.04 cm/count command resolution; field calibrated, repeatability still needs a logged test table | YES - record 10 cm, 25 cm, 50 cm calibration results |
| Vision loop period | Active FPS cap is not set; `waitKey(1)` is a UI delay, not measured FPS | NOT DERIVABLE FROM CODE | YES - measure real FPS |
| YOLO processing cadence | detection is attempted every 3 camera frames | every 3 frames, real Hz depends on measured FPS | YES - log timestamps |
| Frame recovery delay | retry sleep 0.01 s, restart after 30 empty frames | minimum 300 ms before stream restart if all frames are empty | YES - test camera disconnect/recover |
| Obstacle trigger | line mode checks `front_distance < 12` cm | code trigger 12 cm | YES - test approach distance |
| Evacuation approach trigger | front checks at 10 cm, 30 cm, and approach while >15 cm | code thresholds 10/30/15 cm | YES - test in evacuation zone |
| Evacuation side-gap trigger | right distance jump >30 cm or zero reading, after >=3 jumps | code threshold >30 cm, 3 detections | YES - test wall gap |

## Values NOT found in code (must be measured physically)

- Active camera FPS cap or measured FPS -> measure on Raspberry Pi with timestamps.
- Real vision loop period -> `waitKey(1)` is not a FPS guarantee.
- Complete theoretical max speed -> motor RPM and one wheel diameter are in the BOM, but gearing/coupling, all driven wheel diameters, load, slip, and voltage sag must be measured.
- Battery voltage under servo load -> use a multimeter during pickup and deposit.
- Current draw under motor + servo load -> use bench supply or inline meter.
- Pickup success rate -> run 10 attempts per victim type and count successes.
- Color detection accuracy -> test under competition lighting and log confusion matrix.
- Victim detection accuracy -> log true positives/false positives/false negatives on known samples.
- Deposit alignment success -> run 5 left + 5 right deposits and count successes.
- Real turn accuracy -> run 10 x 90 degree and 10 x 180 degree turns, measure final yaw error.
- Real distance accuracy -> run 10 cm, 25 cm, 50 cm commands and measure physical displacement.
- PCB voltage rails under dynamic load -> measure 12 V, 8 V, 6 V, 5 V, and 3.3 V during worst-case motion.
- Servo stall/overheat behavior -> test claw close/lift/deposit repeated cycles.
- Ultrasonic real detection reliability -> test front/left/right at known distances.
